latin: Ordo librorum Methaphysicae post naturales, eo modo quo eos ordinauit Aristoteles, secundum nullum processum, siue compositiuum siue resolutiuum, potest esse rectus.
translation: The sequence in which Aristotle placed the books of the Metaphysics after the books on nature cannot be correct by any method, whether compositive or resolutive.
